meal.title: Creating a New Console Project in Code::Blocks
meal.objective: Start a new C console application project in Code::Blocks

voice.script: Want to see how a fresh C project appears in Code::Blocks? How do you start a new console application in Code::Blocks? A console project is a program that runs in a text window. Open Code::Blocks and choose File then New then Project. Pick Console application, click Go, select C language, then press Next. Give your project a name, choose a folder, and finish. Code::Blocks creates a main file with a simple function that returns zero. You can now type your code and press Build and Run to see the output. Remember, a new console project gives you a ready‑made main function to start coding. Now, create your own console project and run the empty program.
